intro: 12 個僱用與訓練情境高頻字。每個字附兩個例句、中譯,以及用法與衍生字提醒。

ex.en: We plan to conduct the training session in the auditorium.
ex.zh: 我們打算在大禮堂進行這場培訓。

ex.en: The interviews were conducted over a period of three weeks.
ex.zh: 這些面試在三週的期間內進行。

note: 動詞重音在後;名詞 conduct 意為行為、品行

ex.en: The new training program generated a lot of interest among employees.
ex.zh: 新的培訓計畫在員工間引發了高度興趣。

ex.en: The job fair at the college campus should generate interest in our company.
ex.zh: 大學校園的就業博覽會應該能引起大家對我們公司的興趣。

note: generation 產生、世代;generator 發電機

ex.en: The new hire has integrated well with his colleagues.
ex.zh: 這位新進員工與同事相處融洽。

ex.en: She was hired after her third interview.
ex.zh: 她在第三次面試後被錄取了。

note: 名詞 a new hire 新進人員;動詞多用被動 be hired
to employ、to offer a job or position

ex.en: The workers were told that they must keep up with the changes or they would be without jobs.
ex.zh: 員工被告知必須跟上變化,否則會失業。

ex.en: Employees are encouraged to take courses in order to keep up with new developments.
ex.zh: 公司鼓勵員工進修,以跟上新的發展。

note: 四字片語不可分離,受詞放最後

ex.en: Staff members looked up to the director because he had earned their respect over the years.
ex.zh: 員工都敬重這位主管,因為他多年來贏得了他們的尊重。

ex.en: There are few people in this world that I look up to as much as I look up to you.
ex.zh: 這世上很少有人能讓我像敬重你一樣地敬重。

ex.en: The mentor helped her make some decisions about combining career and family.
ex.zh: 這位良師幫助她做出兼顧事業與家庭的決定。

ex.en: Many programs are problematic because mentors don't feel invested in the progress of the employees.
ex.zh: 許多計畫之所以有問題,是因為導師對員工的進展缺乏投入感。

note: a person who guides and instructs、a resource
mentoring 師徒制;mentee 受指導者

ex.en: If we stay on track, the meeting should be finished at 9:30.
ex.zh: 如果我們照進度走,會議應該能在九點半結束。

ex.en: You have a lot of work; if you can't stay on track, let me know immediately.
ex.zh: 你的工作很多,如果無法照進度進行,請立刻告訴我。

ex.en: We put the rejects in this box.
ex.zh: 我們把不合格品放在這個箱子裡。

ex.en: Even though Mr. Lukin rejected their offer, they remained in contact.
ex.zh: 儘管盧金先生拒絕了他們的聘僱條件,雙方仍保持聯繫。

note: 動詞重音在後;名詞重音在前

ex.en: Check with your supervisor to make sure that your office is all set up before you begin work.
ex.zh: 開始工作前請向主管確認你的辦公室都已布置妥當。

ex.en: Set up a time and place for the meeting and then inform everyone who is involved.
ex.zh: 安排好會議的時間地點,然後通知所有相關人員。

note: 可分離片語:set it up;名詞形 setup 寫在一起

ex.en: The director's success came after years of hiring the right people at the right time.
ex.zh: 這位主管的成功,來自多年來在對的時機聘用對的人。

ex.en: When the manager won an award, he attributed his success to his colleagues.
ex.zh: 這位經理獲獎時,把自己的成功歸功於同事。

note: succeed 成功;successful 成功的;successfully 成功地
an accomplishment、the reaching of a goal

ex.en: The new hire received such good training that, within a week, she was as productive as the other workers.
ex.zh: 這位新進員工受到很好的訓練,一週內就和其他員工一樣有生產力。

ex.en: The training is designed to prepare all workers for the changes that the company will face.
ex.zh: 這項訓練旨在讓所有員工為公司將面臨的變化做好準備。

note: on-the-job training 在職訓練;training session 培訓課程
train 訓練;trainee 受訓者;trainer 訓練員

ex.en: He updated the employees on the latest personnel changes.
ex.zh: 他向員工更新了最新的人事異動。

ex.en: We update the calendar weekly.
ex.zh: 我們每週更新行事曆。

note: update sb on sth 向某人更新⋯的消息
動詞重音在後;名詞 an update 重音在前
